headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for AudioControl Concert XR receivers. Expose power and volume-preset switches over the LAN IP control port (default 50000). On the receiver, set **Control** to **IP** and **Standby Mode** to **IP and HDMI ON** so the unit remains reachable while in standby.
footerDisplay: For help, see the [README](https://github.com/tbaur/homebridge-concert#readme). Protocol details for contributors: [docs/PROTOCOL.md](https://github.com/tbaur/homebridge-concert/blob/main/docs/PROTOCOL.md).

name.title: Name
name.description: Plugin instance name shown in the Homebridge log.

host.title: Host / IP Address
host.description: IP address or hostname of the AudioControl Concert receiver. Prefer a static/DHCP reservation.

port.title: Control Port
port.description: TCP port for IP automation control. Default is 50000. Out-of-range values fall back to 50000 at startup.

model.title: Model
model.description: Optional model name shown in HomeKit Accessory Information.

accessories.title: Accessories
accessories.description: HomeKit switches to expose. Add a power switch and optional volume-preset switches (On = at that level).

type.title: Type
type.description: Power toggles standby. Volume preset is On when the zone volume equals the configured level.

name.title: Name
name.description: HomeKit display name for this switch.

volume.title: Volume Level
volume.description: Required for volume preset (0–99). Ignored for power accessories.

refreshRate.title: Refresh Rate (seconds)
refreshRate.description: How often to poll the receiver for accessory state. Default 90 seconds. Values below 5 fall back to 90; values above 86400 are clamped.

condition.functionBody: try { return model.accessories[arrayIndices[0]].type === 'volumePreset'; } catch (e) { return false; }
